nnn_opts.description: Binary options passed to nnn at startup. Common flags: -c (cli-only opener), -n (type-to-nav), -e (open text files in editor), -x (show notifications). Leave empty for defaults.

nnn_opener.description: Custom command or plugin to open files. If empty, uses system default (xdg-open/open).

nnn_bms.description: List of bookmark strings in 'key:location' format. Example: ['d:$HOME/Docs', 'D:$HOME/Downloads']. These are joined with ';' in the env var. Leave empty for no default bookmarks.

nnn_plug.description: List of plugin definitions in 'key:command' format. Example: ['f:finder', 'p:mocplay']. Commands can be prefixed with ! for shell execution. Leave empty for no default plugins.

nnn_order.description: List of sort order overrides in 'key:directory' format. Key is a single character (a/d/e/r/s/t/v). Directory must be absolute. Leave empty for no overrides.

nnn_colors.description: Color scheme for contexts. 8-color string (e.g., '1234') or xterm 256-color hex (e.g., '#0a1b2c3d'). Empty for defaults.

nnn_fcolors.description: File-type specific colors as xterm 256 hex string (2 hex digits per color type, 12 colors total). Empty to use defaults.

nnn_archive.description: Regex pattern for archive extensions to handle silently. Defaults to common compression formats.

nnn_archmnt.description: Utility used to mount archives. Defaults to archivemount.

nnn_sshfs.description: Custom sshfs command with comma-separated options (no spaces). Empty to use default.

nnn_rclone.description: Additional options for rclone mount command. Must be preceded by 'rclone'. Empty to use defaults.

nnn_sel.description: Absolute path to a custom selection file. Empty to use default .selection in config dir.

nnn_fifo.description: Path to a named pipe for writing the hovered file path. Empty to use default or temporary.

nnn_locker.description: Command to run as a terminal locker (e.g., 'cmatrix'). Empty to disable.

nnn_tmpfile.description: Path to a file where the last working directory command is written on quit. Empty to disable.

nnn_help.description: Command to run and display output on the help screen (e.g., 'fortune'). Empty to disable.

nnn_mclick.description: Key sequence emulated by a middle mouse click. Empty to use default.

nnn_no_color.description: If true (1), disables ANSI color output.
